verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a provider-agnostic interface covering Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API. OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM and LM Studio are added via a custom Base URL, and subscriptions like Claude Code, Codex and Grok can serve as native chat backends. Pipe functions add custom models that appear as selectable models in the chat sidebar, and two models can run side-by-side, which supports switching models per conversation. Missing for 10: explicit first-party native connectors for Anthropic and Google APIs (only indirect paths are evidenced), documented per-agent model assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.
